author: Peter Chen
html: It is very sad our community has lost a great scientist and colleague. Jose was very innovative and had been very successful in implementing new ideas into commercial products. He will be missed by many of us.

author: Gio Wiederhold
html:
Sad to hear, too young.
I was the program manager at DARPA supporting TI’s OODB work.
One of the many efforts influencing today’s focus in data.
